scientific_integrity: Full proof given with integral primitive-lattice argument; finite experiments independently corroborate but do not establish the general claim. No authorship, provenance, publication or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the loopless simple undirected length-two full-alphabet overlap graph, not directed flag structures, multigraph chain structures, or longer word length. Computational corroboration is finite, with the infinite statement resting on the uniform proof. Unindexed equivalent work cannot be excluded.
title: Integral two-sphere wedges from two-letter de Bruijn overlap graphs
